rows.grounds: main noun denoting the energy center
second member of compound describing cakraṃ

items.question: What are the defining characteristics of the sixth chakra?
premises: The sixth chakra is described as royal.
The sixth chakra has eight petals.
The sixth chakra possesses a central pericarp.
items.inference: The sixth chakra is a royal, eight-petaled center with a pericarp.
uncertainties: The exact nuance of rājānam as an epithet in this context is interpretive.
items.plain_english: And the sixth chakra is royal, eight-petaled, and endowed with a pericarp.
